name: effect-spotlight-focus
title: Spotlight Focus
description: Lớp tối phủ dần lên các thẻ xung quanh, chừa một lỗ tròn mềm quanh chủ thể, vòng màu khép lại quanh nó.

moworks.author: moworks

options.hole: the clear hole's radius, × half the subject's diagonal (1); full shade at 1.33 ×
options.hold: s before the shade lifts (1.3; null keeps it)
options.context: the element the shade covers (the subject's parent)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Dim layer over the context: opacity 0 → 0.86 in 600 ms power2.out with a soft round hole around the subject (clear to r 42 px, full shade from r 56 px); the subject card stays on top, unshaded; a 1.5 px accent ring fades in while closing from r 58 → 46 px. Exit: shade off in 400 ms power2.inOut after a 1.3 s hold. Params: duration (0.6 s) · dim (0.86) · hole: bán kính lỗ (42–56 px) · ring (1.5 px).
moworks.titleVi: Làm tối xung quanh, rọi chủ thể
